excerpt.zh: 帝国参议院已经通过了一项决议，旨在禁止星海帝国成员国之间的战争。[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]勒令立刻停止所有违反这项新法律的战争。
excerpt.en: The Imperial Senate has passed a resolution that forbids wars between the member states of the Galactic Imperium. All wars in violation of this new law have been brought to an immediate conclusion by order of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle].
